title: Error-Corrected Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Optimal Control of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles under Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2611.27272v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We solve open-loop optimal control problems under parametric uncertainty using a physics-informed DeepONet that returns trajectories for all sampled scenarios in one evaluation. Trained only on the residual at generic controls, the operator is reused across targets and horizons. Because a gradient-based optimizer exploits surrogate errors, we correct the prediction by one Newton step on the dynamics, computed for all scenarios and times by one parallel scan. The corrected state has a second-order error bounded by the residual alone, and the corrected cost is honest for every control up to the sampling error. On a fixed-wing UAV benchmark, the corrected operator matches the accuracy of a batched Adam solver and an Ipopt solver at equal sample size and is 8 times faster than the Adam solver on the same GPU at a few hundred scenarios and 15 times faster than Ipopt on a CPU.

translated_title: 面向不确定性条件下无人机最优控制的误差校正物理信息神经算子
translated_abstract: 我们使用物理信息DeepONet求解参数不确定性下的开环最优控制问题，该算子通过单次评估即可返回所有采样场景的轨迹。该算子仅在通用控制下的残差上进行训练，因此可在不同目标和时域上重复使用。由于基于梯度的优化器会利用代理模型的误差，我们通过对动力学方程执行一次牛顿步来校正预测，该计算通过一次并行扫描即可对所有场景和时间完成。校正后的状态具有仅由残差界定的二阶误差，且校正后的成本对任意控制在采样误差范围内是准确可靠的。在固定翼无人机基准测试中，在相同样本量下，校正后的算子达到了批量Adam求解器和Ipopt求解器的精度；在数百个场景的规模下，在同一GPU上比Adam求解器快8倍，在CPU上比Ipopt快15倍。
tldr: 该论文提出一种误差校正的物理信息神经算子，通过一次牛顿步校正预测误差来求解不确定性条件下的无人机开环最优控制问题，其精度可匹敌传统求解器且速度快8至15倍。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an error-corrected physics-informed neural operator that uses one Newton step to correct prediction errors for open-loop optimal control of UAVs under uncertainty, matching traditional solvers' accuracy while being 8-15 times faster.
